newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat firm on mill buying, spillover.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat firm on mill buying, spillover.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures were firm at the midsession on mill buying and spillover support from other U.S. wheat markets, traders said.

"There's less price action compared to yesterday... but more commercial paper," a trader said. "The mills have been buyers, with Atwood-Peavey, ADM and General Mills each buying between 300,000 and 400,000 March."

Wheat futures in Kansas City and Chicago were buoyed by concerns over possible winterkill damage that could result from the bitter cold temperatures expected in the central U.S. Plains later this week.
At 1037 CST, MGE spring wheat was one to three cents per bushel higher, with March up three cents at $3.87-1/4.
Country Hedging and LFG each sold around 300,000 March bushels, and traders said the March/May spread traded at 12-1/2 cents.
